rows.grounds: numeral forming quantity with following noun
compound: yoni (womb) + yantra (device); locative plural of locus
past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-devices are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
The loci of affliction are womb-devices.
Beings within these loci are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment throughout the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-devices.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-devices.
